subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Boundary Value Analysis
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Boundary Value Analysis.

hook.text: A field accepts 1–100. It works at 50. But does it work at 0, 1, 100, and 101? Bugs love boundaries.

buildup.text: Boundary value analysis tests at the edges of valid ranges—the exact boundaries where behavior should change.

discovery.text: Test the boundary itself, one below, and one above: 0, 1, 100, 101. Four tests cover what matters most.

twist.text: Off-by-one errors are the most common programming mistake. Boundary testing is designed to catch exactly those.

climax.text: Combining boundary analysis with equivalence partitioning creates a small but powerful test set.

punchline.text: Bugs cluster at boundaries. Test the edges first.

quiz.question: Why are boundary values important to test?
options: Off-by-one errors are the most common programming mistake
